connector.name: HTML to Image
connector.registryDescription: Render HTML and CSS to PNG images over HTTP. Send HTML and CSS and get a PNG back.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.html2img.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.html2img, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your HTML to Image API key as a bearer token, for example 'Bearer htim_...'. Create one in your html2img.com dashboard.
